== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]] (Virtual Block 2 slip 36), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-36-I_m_Sorry.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-imsorry-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Master List (Dark Side)], official text as of 27 April 2013 (Internet Archive). The deploy (▼) and Immune to Alter icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy a Floating Refinery, a cloud sector (to Bespin), or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6385</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>11_72</code>, title, lore, icons, concept credit, slip number 36, Virtual Block 2 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.

'''Renamed 11 November 2026 (Batch B41 rework):''' from VB2-36-I_m_Sorry-PC-E3-cardmaker.png; this recreation now shows version E4 (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip are versions of their own, so the later versions were renumbered).
